offerings.description: A French accredited platform (PA) with a free, self-serve sandbox.

sandbox.notes: Free self-serve account at superpdp.tech; test enterprises and OAuth2 client_credentials pairs created under Applications -> New Application. Outbound deposit proven live 2026-08-29 (fr:200->201->202, superpdp sandbox). Inbound reception proven live 2026-09-16 (self-addressed deposit, listInvoices(direction:'in'), downloadInvoiceFile real PDF bytes) -- see pdp-reception.ts's own header. pushLifecycleStatus (buyer-side status push) is live-verified NEGATIVE on this sandbox (every code tried answered 404) -- capabilities.lifecycleStatuses above is true on the strength of the SELLER-side fr:200/201/202/213 status poll, proven live and reproduced five times (pdp-status-poller.ts, superpdp-conformity.live.spec.ts), not the buyer-side push.

provenance.sourceText: backend/src/modules/documents/transports/pdp-transport.ts header: "The client (pdp/pdp-client.ts) and the round-trip shape are REPRISED from git tag avant-refonte-documents - a real deposit was proven end-to-end there (fr:200->201->202, superpdp sandbox, 2026-08-29)"; documentation/docs/developer-guide/credentials-guide.md section 2: "https://api.superpdp.tech serves both sandbox and production (the credential pair decides which)" and "this codebase always speaks SuperPDP's proprietary API Flux".

offerings.notes: Sandbox and production share the SAME host (api.superpdp.tech); which one a deposit reaches is decided by the credential pair, not the URL -- credentials-guide.md is explicit that the two are not distinguished by baseUrl for this vendor, unlike most other pdp-family operators below. The generic 'pdp' transport also speaks the AFNOR XP Z12-013 interoperability API in principle (PdpApiStyle = 'superpdp' | 'afnor'), which would let it reach OTHER conformant PAs through the same baseUrl-swap mechanism this catalogue models -- but nothing in this codebase currently wires that env var, so today the 'pdp' transport in practice only ever proven-reaches SuperPDP.
